core.big_idea: God gave hope within judgment by promising that evil would not win forever.

core.metanarrative_position: Hope appears inside judgment: evil does not get the final word

claims.statement: Genesis 3:15 speaks of conflict between the serpent and the woman’s offspring and of the serpent’s head being struck.
Christians read this early hope within the larger story culminating in Jesus’ victory over sin and evil.
Kids are taught this as early rescue hope rather than required to master technical messianic interpretation.
claims.interpretive_hinge: This conclusion depends on the approved curriculum framework and its distinction between direct text, synthesis, inference, and age-appropriate application; Scripture does not directly mandate this exact curriculum formulation.
